spec.expr:
# Prompt throuput tokens/s
sum by (job, model_name)(
    rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_total[1m])
)

# Generation throughput
sum by(job, model_name)(
    rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])
)
max by (UUID, gpu, device, pci_bus_id)(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL)

max by(UUID, gpu, device, pci_bus_id)(
    DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED
    /
    clamp_min(
    DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE, 1
    )
)
up{job="dcgm-exporter"}
sum(nginx_connections_active{job="nginx"})
sum(nginx_connections_reading{job="nginx"})
sum(nginx_connections_writing{job="nginx"})
sum(nginx_connections_waiting{job="nginx"})

# TTFT P99
histogram_quantile(
    0.99,
    sum by(le, job, model_name)(
        rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[1m])
    )
)

# TTFT P95
histogram_quantile(
    0.95,
    sum by(le, job, model_name)(
        rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[1m])
    )
)
sum by (job, model_name)(rate(vllm:request_success_total[1m]))

# TPOT P99
histogram_quantile(
    0.99,
    sum by (le, job, model_name)(
        rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket[1m])
    )
)

# TPOT P95
histogram_quantile(
    0.95,
    sum by (le, job, model_name)(
        rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket[1m])
    )
)

# E2E P99
histogram_quantile(
    0.99,
    sum by (le, job, model_name)(
        rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[1m])
    )
)

# E2E P95
histogram_quantile(
    0.95,
    sum by (le, job, model_name)(
        rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[1m])
    )
)

# KV Cache Usage
max by (job, model_name)(
    vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc
)

# Running 请求数
sum by (job, model_name)(
    vllm:num_requests_running
)

# Waiting 请求数
sum by (job, model_name)(
    vllm:num_requests_waiting
)

# preemption
sum by (job, model_name)(
    increase(vllm:num_preemptions_total[5m])
)
